items.headline: No. 22 Houston routs Southern 77-6 in game played briefly without stadium lights
items.description: — Conner Weigman threw for 120 yards and three touchdowns before giving way to his backup, and No. 22 Houston routed Southern 77-6 Saturday night in a game played briefly without stadium lights due to a power outage.
